qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise service territories in Wisconsin (WPL) and Iowa (IPL). Non-replicable electric and gas transmission/distribution grid provides natural monopoly toll-booth economics, with authorized ROE of ~9.8-10.0% protected by constructive state regulatory compacts.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric and gas monopoly utility serving Iowa and Wisconsin with constructive regulatory relations. However, heavy ongoing capital expenditures ($2.28B capex vs $1.17B OCF in FY2025) generate continuous negative free cash flow and elevate long-term debt to $11.0B (13.5x net income) with thin 2.00x interest coverage, requiring perpetual reliance on debt and equity capital markets.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of $4.36B, EBIT of $1,025M, and net income of $810M. 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 5.01%. Balance sheet carries $10.95B in long-term debt against $556M cash, resulting in 13.5x debt/NI (threshold <=4.0x) and 2.00x interest coverage (EBIT $1,025M / Interest $512M, threshold >5.0x).
